title: The Amazing Spider-Man #203 Apr 1980, Marvel Comics
descriptionText: The product is a vintage comic book, specifically The Amazing Spider-Man #203 from April 1980, published by Marvel Comics during the Bronze Age era. The comic features the popular character Spider-Man and falls within the genre of comics. As a collector's item, this vintage comic captures a piece of comic book history and is a must-have for fans of Spider-Man and US Comics.
